title: Subscription
description: Your getproperty plan, what is counted, invoices from getproperty and the hardware at your buildings.

readOnly.title: Your account is read-only
readOnly.body: The subscription is suspended for an unpaid invoice ({count, plural, one {# open} other {# open}}). Pay it with the Thai QR below; the account reopens once getproperty confirms the payment.

pastDue.title: Payment overdue
pastDue.body: An invoice from getproperty is overdue since {date}. Pay it to avoid suspension.

trial.title: Free trial
trial.body: The trial ends on {date}; the first invoice follows.

noneHint: getproperty sets up your plan when you sign up.
estimateHint: From what is counted so far; the invoice follows at the end of the month.
invoicesHint: Pay each one with its Thai QR; the PDF is the tax invoice.
usageHint: What was counted each month and charged for it.
hardwareHint: Platform devices rented at your buildings.
surveysHint: Upgrading to Smart starts with a survey of the building.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to Apartment Smart
upgrade.hint: Smart meters read themselves. A field engineer first surveys one building (meters, network, power) and proposes the installation; your plan changes once it is installed.
upgrade.notesHint: Access, best days, contact on site
